name: Ecclesiasticism
overview: The Scriptures reveal that ecclesiasticism, particularly in its Jewish form, was characterized by rigid adherence to traditional rules and an arrogance that Jesus openly rebuked. In Matthew 9, Jesus challenges the Pharisees for their judgmental attitude toward His association with sinners, emphasizing mercy over sacrifice and highlighting the need for repentance rather than self-righteousness. Similarly, in Matthew 12, Jesus confronts their legalistic interpretation of Sabbath laws, pointing to examples like David to demonstrate that compassion and necessity transcend strict observance. These passages underscore that the religious system Jesus encountered was to be overthrown because it hindered true understanding and mercy.
